local function piece(model, name, size, position, color, shape, rotation, material)
	local part = Instance.new(shape == "Wedge" and "WedgePart" or "Part")
	if shape and shape ~= "Wedge" then part.Shape = Enum.PartType[shape] end
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = Vector(size[1], size[2], size[3])
	part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position[1], position[2], position[3])
		* (rotation and CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rotation[1]), math.rad(rotation[2]), math.rad(rotation[3])) or CFrame.identity)
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Parent = model
	return part
end

local function modelWithCore(name, size)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = name
	local core = piece(model, "Core", size, {0, 0, 0}, dark)
	core.Transparency = 1
	model.PrimaryPart = core
	return model
end

local function particle(parent, position, profile)
	local source = Instance.new("Attachment")
	source.Position = position
	source.Parent = parent
	local effect = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	effect.Name = profile.name or "AtmosphericDetail"
	effect.Texture = profile.texture or smokeTexture
	effect.Color = ColorSequence.new(profile.color, profile.fade or profile.color)
	effect.Size = NumberSequence.new(profile.size, profile.endSize or profile.size * 1.65)
	effect.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, profile.opacity or 0.36),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, profile.opacity or 0.36),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	effect.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(profile.life * 0.7, profile.life)
	effect.Rate = profile.rate
	effect.Speed = NumberRange.new(profile.speed * 0.45, profile.speed)
	effect.EmissionDirection = profile.direction or Enum.NormalId.Top
	effect.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(profile.spread or 28, profile.spread or 28)
	effect.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-180, 180)
	effect.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-18, 26)
	effect.LightEmission = profile.emission or 0.2
	effect.LightInfluence = profile.lightInfluence or 0.18
	effect.Enabled = profile.enabled ~= false
	effect.Parent = source
	return effect
end

local function accent(model, name, size, position, color, shape, rotation, material)
	local part = piece(model, name, size, position, color, shape, rotation, material)
	part:SetAttribute("Decoration", true)
	return part
end

local function scaleNumberSequence(seq, factor)
	local keypoints = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do
		table.insert(keypoints, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, kp.Value * factor, kp.Envelope * factor))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(keypoints)
end

local function scaleModelVisuals(model, scale)
	model:SetAttribute("VisualScale", scale)
	if scale == 1 then
		return
	end
	model:ScaleTo(scale)
	for _, desc in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			local center = desc:GetAttribute("FlockCenter")
			if typeof(center) == "Vector3" then
				desc:SetAttribute("FlockCenter", center * scale)
			end
			local jointScale = desc:GetAttribute("JointScale")
			if typeof(jointScale) == "number" then
				desc:SetAttribute("JointScale", jointScale * scale)
			end
		elseif desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			desc.Size = scaleNumberSequence(desc.Size, scale)
			desc.Speed = NumberRange.new(desc.Speed.Min * scale, desc.Speed.Max * scale)
		elseif desc:IsA("Beam") then
			desc.Width0 *= scale
			desc.Width1 *= scale
		end
	end
end

local enemyTemplates = {}
local hailVariant = 0

function Art.Enemy(name)
	local templateName = name
	if name == "Hailstone" then
		hailVariant = hailVariant % 3 + 1
		templateName = hailVariant == 1 and name or name .. hailVariant
	end
	local template = enemyTemplates[templateName]
	if not template then
		template = Visuals.Enemy(templateName)
		if template then
			template.Name = name
			Visuals.EnemyEffects(template, name)
		else
			template = modelWithCore(name, {3.2, 2.6, 3.5})
			enemyBuilders[name](template)
		end
		scaleModelVisuals(template, ENEMY_SCALES[name] or 1.9)
		enemyTemplates[templateName] = template
	end
	return template:Clone()
end

local function streak(model, start, finish, color, width, active)
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a.Position = start
	a.Parent = root
	local b = Instance.new("Attachment")
	b.Position = finish
	b.Parent = root
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Name = active and "ActiveBeam" or "WarningBeam"
	beam.Attachment0 = a
	beam.Attachment1 = b
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.LightEmission = 0.65
	beam.LightInfluence = 0
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	beam.Width0 = width
	beam.Width1 = width
	beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(active and 0.12 or 0.32)
	beam.Enabled = not active
	beam.Parent = a
	return beam
end

local function ring(model, center, radius, color, name, strike)
	for quarter = 0, 3 do
		local a = quarter * math.pi / 2
		local b = a + math.pi / 2
		local line = streak(model, center + Vector(math.cos(a), 0, math.sin(a)) * radius,
			center + Vector(math.cos(b), 0, math.sin(b)) * radius, color, 0.63)
		line.Attachment0.Axis = Vector(-math.sin(a), 0, math.cos(a))
		line.Attachment1.Axis = Vector(-math.sin(b), 0, math.cos(b))
		line.CurveSize0 = radius * 0.5523
		line.CurveSize1 = radius * 0.5523
		line.Segments = 9
		line.Name = name
		line.LightEmission = 0.38
		if strike then line:SetAttribute("StrikeWarning", strike) end
	end
end

local function boundaryPosts(model, center, radius, color)
	for _, direction in {Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.zAxis} do
		local foot = center + direction * radius
		local post = streak(model, foot - Vector(0, 3, 0), foot + Vector(0, 11, 0), color, 1.05)
		post.Name = "BoundaryPost"
		post.Width1 = 0.26
		post.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 0.12),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.9),
		})
	end
end

local function vortex(model, color, radius, height)
	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	local shadow = color:Lerp(dark, 0.58)
	for layer = 1, 4 do
		local r = radius * (0.32 + layer * 0.16)
		local y = (layer / 4 - 0.56) * height
		for arm = 0, 1 do
			local startAngle = layer * 1.28 + arm * math.pi
			local a = Vector(math.cos(startAngle) * r, y, math.sin(startAngle) * r)
			local endAngle = startAngle + 2.05
			local b = Vector(math.cos(endAngle) * (r + 2), y + 5.5, math.sin(endAngle) * (r + 2))
			local ribbon = streak(model, a, b, color, 4.7 + layer * 0.7)
			ribbon.Name = "VortexRibbon"
			ribbon.Attachment0.Axis = Vector(-math.sin(startAngle), 0.19, math.cos(startAngle))
			ribbon.Attachment1.Axis = Vector(-math.sin(endAngle), 0.17, math.cos(endAngle))
			ribbon.CurveSize0 = r * 0.76
			ribbon.CurveSize1 = r * 0.85
			ribbon.Width1 = ribbon.Width0 * 0.42
			ribbon.Segments = 18
			ribbon.LightEmission = 0.46
			ribbon.Color = ColorSequence.new(shadow:Lerp(color, 0.45), color:Lerp(ivory, 0.42))
			ribbon.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.86),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.37, 0.27),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
			})
			for _, endpoint in {ribbon.Attachment0, ribbon.Attachment1} do
				endpoint:SetAttribute("SpiralRate", layer * 0.33 + arm * 0.17)
			end
		end

	end
end

local function bolt(model, start, finish, color, strike)
	local previous = start
	for index = 1, 6 do
		local point = start:Lerp(finish, index / 6)
		if index < 6 then point += Vector(math.sin(index * 3.5) * 6, 0, math.cos(index * 2.6) * 4) end
		local main = streak(model, previous, point, color, 1.18, true)
		if strike then main:SetAttribute("Strike", strike) end
		if index == 2 or index == 4 then
			local branch = streak(model, point, point + Vector(index == 2 and -11 or 9, -9, 5), color, 0.48, true)
			branch.Width1 = 0.1
			if strike then branch:SetAttribute("Strike", strike) end
		end
		previous = point
	end
end

local function ruinModel(index, offset)
	local imported = Visuals.Clone("Ruin" .. ((index - 1) % 3 + 1))
	if imported then
		imported.Name = "Ruin" .. index
		imported:PivotTo(CFrame.new(offset))
		return imported
	end
	local ruin = modelWithCore("Ruin" .. index, {1, 1, 1})
	local slate = rgb(77, 87, 103)
	local stone = index % 2 == 0 and rgb(168, 143, 112) or rgb(195, 171, 134)
	local trim = rgb(218, 174, 99)
	piece(ruin, "FracturedFoundation", {15, 3.6, 13}, {0, -8, 0}, slate, "Wedge", {0, index * 37, -12}, Enum.Material.Slate)
	piece(ruin, "LowerPlinth", {12.4, 1.9, 10.2}, {0, -6, 0}, stone, "Block", {0, index * 8, 6}, Enum.Material.Sandstone)
	piece(ruin, "UpperPlinth", {9.5, 1.6, 7.4}, {0.8, -4.8, -0.5}, slate, "Block", {0, index * 8, 7}, Enum.Material.Slate)
	local lean = 76 + index * 7
	local lastCourse = index == 2 and 2 or 3

local wingParts = {Wing = true, FlightFeather = true, Membrane = true, WingTip = true, AmberWing = true, CrystalWing = true}

local function add(model, position, velocity, name, effect, delaySeconds, lifespan, health, accentColor)
	local shootable = health ~= nil
	model.Name = name
	model:SetAttribute("IsObstacle", true)
	model:SetAttribute("Shootable", shootable)
	model:SetAttribute("Health", health or 0)
	if health ~= nil then
		model:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", health)
	end
	if typeof(accentColor) == "Color3" then
		model:SetAttribute("HitColor", accentColor)
	end
	if not shootable and (effect == "Tornado" or effect == "Storm") and model.PrimaryPart then
		local vortexCore = Instance.new("Part")
		vortexCore.Name = "VortexQueryCore"
		vortexCore.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		vortexCore.Size = effect == "Storm" and Vector3.new(44, 18, 18) or Vector3.new(36, 13, 13)
		vortexCore.CFrame = CFrame.new(model.PrimaryPart.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
		vortexCore.Transparency = 1
		vortexCore.Anchored = true
		vortexCore.CanCollide = false
		vortexCore.CanTouch = false
		vortexCore.CanQuery = true
		vortexCore.Parent = model
	end
	local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local minY = safeY + size.Y / 2
	local visualScale = model:GetAttribute("VisualScale") or 1
	local fadeDuration = (shootable and delaySeconds == 0) and 0.45 or (delaySeconds > 0 and 0.85 or 0)
	local beams = {}
	local fragments = {}
	local fadeParts = {}
	local animated = {}
	local spirals = {}
	local rails = {}
	for _, object in model:GetDescendants() do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			if shootable then
				object.CanQuery = not object:GetAttribute("Decoration")
			elseif object.Name == "VortexQueryCore" then
				object.CanQuery = true
			elseif object.Name == "MeteorFragment" then
				object.CanQuery = false
			else
				object.CanQuery = queryableHazards[effect] == true and (not object:GetAttribute("Decoration")) and object.Transparency < 0.99
			end
			if object.Name == "MeteorFragment" then
				fragments[object] = object.Transparency
				object.Transparency = 1
			elseif fadeDuration > 0 and object.Name ~= "VortexQueryCore" and object.Transparency < 1 then
				table.insert(fadeParts, { part = object, target = object.Transparency, query = object.CanQuery })
				object.Transparency = 1
				object.CanQuery = false
			end
		elseif object:IsA("Beam") then
			table.insert(beams, object)
			local lane = object:GetAttribute("MeteorLane")
			if lane then
				rails[lane] = rails[lane] or {}
				table.insert(rails[lane], object)
			end
		elseif object:IsA("Attachment") then
			local rate = object:GetAttribute("SpiralRate")
			if rate then table.insert(spirals, {attachment = object, rest = object.CFrame, rate = rate}) end
		end
	end
	position = Vector3.new(position.X, math.max(minY, position.Y), position.Z)
	local pose = (shootable or effect == "Spike") and CFrame.lookAt(position, position + velocity) or CFrame.new(position)
	model:PivotTo(pose)
	for _, part in model:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and (wingParts[part.Name] or part:GetAttribute("FlockCenter")
			or part.Name == "Thunderhead" or part.Name == "ChargedCrystal") then
			local center = part:GetAttribute("FlockCenter") or Vector3.zero
			local jointScale = part:GetAttribute("JointScale") or visualScale
			table.insert(animated, { part = part, rest = pose:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame), center = center, jointScale = jointScale })
		end
	end
	model.Parent = folder
	local now = os.clock()
	local item = {
		instance = model, velocity = velocity, shootable = shootable, effect = effect,
		born = now, activeAt = now + delaySeconds, expires = now + delaySeconds + lifespan,
		minY = minY, hit = {}, beams = beams, fragments = fragments, animated = animated, origin = pose,
		spirals = spirals, rails = rails, visualScale = visualScale, fadeParts = fadeParts,
		fadeDuration = fadeDuration, fadeDone = (fadeDuration <= 0 or #fadeParts == 0),
	}
	table.insert(Manager.activeObstacles, item)
	return item
end

local function stepFade(item, now)
	local alpha = math.clamp((now - item.born) / item.fadeDuration, 0, 1)
	local queryReady = alpha >= 0.25
	for _, entry in ipairs(item.fadeParts) do
		entry.part.Transparency = 1 - (1 - entry.target) * alpha
		if queryReady and not entry.querySet then
			entry.querySet = true
			entry.part.CanQuery = entry.query
		end
	end
	if alpha >= 1 then
		item.fadeDone = true
	end

	local flank = math.rad(68) * (math.random(0, 1) == 0 and -1 or 1)

function Manager.SpawnBand(index, fd, hazard)
	local spec = bands[index]
	local pacing = Config.OBSTACLE_PACING[index]
	if not spec or stormBlocksSpawn(fd, os.clock())
		or not Manager.GetBand(fd.altitudeKm) or #Manager.activeObstacles >= obstacleLimit then return nil end

	local predicted = predictedEnvelope(fd)
	if not hazard then
		return spawnEnemy(spec, pacing, predicted + horizLead(fd, 1.5, 20), math.rad(math.random(-55, 55)), 1, verticalSpeed(fd))
	end

	local path = pickTrajectory(spec.effect)
	local lead = horizLead(fd, warningSeconds * 0.65, 28)
	if lead.Magnitude < 3 and (spec.effect == "Lightning" or spec.effect == "Storm") then
		lead = Vector3.new(math.random(-14, 14), 0, math.random(-22, -6))
	end
	local impact = predictedEnvelope(fd, warningSeconds + hazardSeconds / 2) + lead
	local start = impact - path / 2
	local warningApproach = nil
	if spec.effect == "Debris" or spec.effect == "Magnetic" then
		local angle = math.rad(math.random(-120, 120))
		warningApproach = Vector3.new(math.sin(angle) * 82, 18, -math.cos(angle) * 82)
	end
	local cells = spec.effect == "Storm" and stormCells or ruinCells
	local model = Art.Hazard(spec.effect, spec.color, path, cells)
	local item = add(model, start + (warningApproach or Vector3.zero), path / hazardSeconds, spec.hazard, spec.effect, warningSeconds, hazardSeconds, nil, spec.color)
	item.origin = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(start.X, math.max(item.minY, start.Y), start.Z))
	item.warningApproach = warningApproach
	if path.Magnitude > 0 then item.path = path end
	if spec.effect == "Meteor" or spec.effect == "Debris" then
		item.groups = {}
		for index = 1, spec.effect == "Meteor" and 3 or #ruinCells do
			local prefix = spec.effect == "Meteor" and "MeteorLane" or "Ruin"

				})
			end
		end
	end
	return item
end

local function touches(item, center, first, last, age)
	local offset = center - last
	local effect = item.effect
	if effect == "Lightning" then
		return Motion.InColumn(offset, Motion.LightningLow, Motion.LightningHigh)
	elseif effect == "Storm" then
		if offset.Magnitude < Motion.StormRadius then return true end
		local x = stormCells[item.strike]
		return x ~= nil and Motion.InColumn(offset - Vector3.new(x, 0, 0), -28, 54)
	elseif effect == "Debris" then
		for _, ruin in ipairs(item.groups) do
			if (center - ruin:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude <= 23 then return true end
		end
		return false
	elseif effect == "Meteor" then
		for _, sweep in pairs(item.laneSweeps) do
			if Motion.DistanceToPath(center, sweep.first, sweep.last) <= Motion.MeteorRadius then return true end
		end
		return false
	elseif effect == "Wind" or effect == "Heat" then
		return math.abs(offset.X) <= 41 and math.abs(offset.Y) <= 23
			and (math.abs(offset.Z) <= 23 or Motion.DistanceToPath(center, first, last) <= 23)
	elseif effect == "Magnetic" and age < 0.35 then
		return false
	end
	local radius = (item.shootable or effect == "Spike") and 18 or 33
	return Motion.DistanceToPath(center, first, last) < radius
end

local function applyHazard(item, flight, now)
	if flight.invulnTime > 0 then return end
	local effect = item.effect
	if effect == "Magnetic" then
		flight.reverseUntil = now + 4
	elseif effect == "Wind" or effect == "Tornado" then
		if flight.windSource ~= item.born or now >= (flight.windUntil or 0) then flight.windSince = now end
		flight.windSource = item.born
		local distance = (flight.balloon.Envelope.Position - item.instance.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude
		local strength = effect == "Tornado" and 25 * math.clamp(1 - distance / 33, 0, 1) or 25
		flight.wind = Vector3.new(strength, 0, 0)
		flight.windUntil = now + (effect == "Tornado" and 0.6 or 3)
	elseif effect == "Fog" then
		for _, player in ipairs(flight.players) do
			if player.Parent == game.Players then
				remotes.HazardAlertEvent:FireClient(player, {hazardName = "Kabut Hampa", effect = "Fog", duration = 5})
			end
		end
	else
		_G.FlyHighBalloonManager.ApplyPuncture(flight)
	end
end

local function activate(item)
	for _, beam in ipairs(item.beams) do
		if beam.Name == "ActiveBeam" then
			beam.Enabled = item.effect ~= "Storm"
		elseif beam.Name == "PathBeam" or (item.effect == "Lightning" and beam.Name == "WarningBeam") then
			beam.Enabled = false

	end

local function animateParts(item, pose, age)

		item.nextSpiralUpdate = age + 1 / 24

			ribbon.attachment.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, age * ribbon.rate, 0) * ribbon.rest

	for index, data in ipairs(item.animated) do
		local part, rest, center = data.part, data.rest, data.center
		local phase = math.sign(center.X) * 1.6
		if item.shootable then
			local spread = Vector3.xAxis * math.sign(center.X) * math.abs(math.sin(age * 1.55)) * (1.3 * item.visualScale)
			local transform = CFrame.new(spread)
			if wingParts[part.Name] then
				local side = math.sign(rest.Position.X - center.X)
				local joint = center + Vector3.new(side * 0.68, 0.35, 0) * data.jointScale
				local flap = side * Motion.WingAngle(item.effect, age, phase)
				transform *= CFrame.new(joint) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, flap) * CFrame.new(-joint)
			end
			part.CFrame = pose * transform * rest
		elseif part.Name == "Thunderhead" then
			local descendY = age < warningSeconds and (1 - math.clamp(age / (warningSeconds * 0.75), 0, 1)) ^ 2 * 28 or 0
			part.CFrame = pose * (rest + Vector3.new(math.sin(age * 1.1 + index) * 2.5, descendY + math.sin(age * 1.3 + index) * 1.2, 0))
		else
			part.CFrame = pose * rest * CFrame.Angles(age * 0.45, age * 0.8, 0)
		end
	end

local function updateMeteor(item, age)
	item.laneSweeps = item.laneSweeps or {}
	for index, lane in ipairs(item.groups) do
		local previous = Motion.MeteorProgress(index, item.previousAge or 0, hazardSeconds)
		local progress = Motion.MeteorProgress(index, age, hazardSeconds)
		local visible = progress >= 0 and progress <= 1
		if lane:GetAttribute("Visible") ~= visible then
			lane:SetAttribute("Visible", visible)
			for _, part in lane:GetDescendants() do
				if item.fragments[part] ~= nil then
					part.Transparency = visible and item.fragments[part] or 1
					part.CanQuery = visible
				end
				if part:IsA("Beam") then part.Enabled = visible end
				if part:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
					part.Enabled = visible
					if visible then part:Emit(5) end
				end
			end
		end
		local railPhase = progress < 0 and "Waiting" or visible and "Passing" or "Passed"
		if lane:GetAttribute("RailPhase") ~= railPhase then
			lane:SetAttribute("RailPhase", railPhase)
			for _, rail in ipairs(item.rails[index]) do
				rail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(visible and 0.63 or 0.32)
				rail.Enabled = railPhase ~= "Passed"
			end
		end
		if progress >= 0 and previous <= 1 then
			local start = item.origin.Position + Motion.MeteorOffset(item.path, index)
			local last = start + item.path * math.clamp(progress, 0, 1)
			local first = start + item.path * math.clamp(previous, 0, 1)
			item.laneSweeps[index] = { first = first, last = last }
			lane:PivotTo(CFrame.new(last) * CFrame.Angles(age * 2.6, age * 1.7, age * 1.2))
			-- The tail follows the flight path while the fragments tumble.
			local wake = lane:FindFirstChild("MeteorWake", true)
			wake.Attachment1.WorldPosition = last - item.path.Unit * 26
		else
			item.laneSweeps[index] = nil
		end
	end
end
